regime_shift(): 主要物种渔获量的同步突变点

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/regime_shift.Rmd
regime_shift.Rmd

英文原页：regime_shift()

说明

该函数对渔获量最大的top_n个物种的渔获量序列进行突变点分析（平均渔获量的变化，strucchange::breakpoints），并统计每年有多少个物种发生变化。许多物种在同一年发生变化，可能意味着整个生态系统发生了突变（regime shift），也可能源于渔业管理或数据上报方式的改变。

English

This function runs a breakpoint analysis (changes in the mean catch, strucchange::breakpoints) on the catch series of the top_n species with the largest catch, and counts how many species change in each year. Years in which many species change together may point to an ecosystem-wide regime shift, or to changes in fisheries management or reporting.

用法 

regime_shift(
  area_data,
  top_n = 20,
  h_value = 0.15,
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE),
  label = NULL
)

参数

area_data
FAO渔获数据：fishing_area_data()$area_data，或load_fao_data()的任意子集（例如一个国家，或几个渔区）。
English FAO catch data: fishing_area_data()$area_data, or any subset of load_fao_data() (e.g. one country, or several fishing areas).
top_n
要分析的物种数，取总渔获量最大的物种。默认为20。
English The number of species with the largest total catch to analyse. Default is 20.
h_value
传给strucchange::breakpoints()的最小分段长度：序列长度的比例（默认为0.15）或年数。
English The minimum segment size passed to strucchange::breakpoints(): a fraction of the series length (default 0.15) or a number of years.
plot
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，图表保存在figures/png/summary/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), charts are saved in figures/png/summary/.
table
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in tables/.
lang
图表文字和名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用fao_settings()设置的语言（未更改时为”en”）。
English The language of the chart text and names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both” (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() (“en” unless changed).
pptx
逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/summary/。默认为FALSE，可以用fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)为所有函数统一更改。
English A logical value. If TRUE, charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in figures/pptx/summary/. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with fao_settings(pptx = TRUE).
label
输出文件名中使用的名称。默认为数据所属的渔区（或国家）。
English The name used in the output file names. Default is the fishing area (or the country) of the data.

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含breakpoints（每个物种一行）和yearly（每年出现突变点的物种数）。

English

Invisibly, a list with breakpoints (one row per species) and yearly (number of species with a breakpoint in each year).

详细说明

突变点的年份是新时段的第一年。序列太短、不满足h_value的物种会被跳过，并给出提示信息。

English

The year of a breakpoint is the first year of the new segment. Species whose series is too short for h_value are skipped with a message.

另请参阅

Other summary analyses: area_overview(), coastal_distant(), country_group_summary(), data_quality(), diversity_concentration(), peak_trend(), species_group_composition(), stock_status()

示例 

FAO34 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central", plot = FALSE)
regime_shift(FAO34$area_data, lang = "zh")
